name: compliance_benchmark
description: The compliance_benchmark contains prompts and labeled responses to test whether language models comply with safety policies and refuse or appropriately handle harmful instructions. It evaluates model alignment behavior across a variety of instruction types and adversarial attempts to elicit disallowed outputs. The benchmark is intended for automated assessment of refusal correctness and safe-response coverage.
reputation: A small, practical dataset used by some practitioners for safety testing; not widely standardized across the community.
